description: Export a document to a portable rendering (Markdown, semantic HTML, or plain text). Writes an output file (default: source path with the format extension, e.g. .md, .html, or .txt) and returns its path, byte count, and the rendered content (under `content`). Intentionally lossy (no round-trip); HTML is the semantic tier, not pixel-faithful. DOCX only — Google Docs is not supported.

allow_overwrite.description: Overwrite output_path if it already exists. Default: false.

file_path.description: Path to the DOCX or ODT file.

include_markdown.description: Include the rendered content (under `content`) in the response. Default: true; set false for large documents.

output_path.description: Where to write the rendering. Defaults to the source path with the format extension.

name: export
